language_coverage.additional_indian_languages: Extensible; include community/regional/tribal languages when reviewed data, scripts, rights and reviewers are available.
language_coverage.global: Extensible language registry; prioritize by user demand, reliable data, script/font, speech support and evaluation.
rules: Preserve original script and proper names

cartoon_family.core_visual_prompt: An original AI miniature 3D cartoon family standing on a giant kitchen table, toy-sized proportions, ultra-cute expressive faces, vibrant colours, cinematic lighting, highly detailed animated-movie style.
cartoon_family.setting_role: Recurring optional miniature-scale learning world; the kitchen table is a visual device, not a food-only topic constraint.
cartoon_family.originality: Use original character designs and voices; do not copy recognizable copyrighted characters, studio-specific designs or signature scenes.

content_styles.invariant: Style may change presentation, never factual, safety, identity, or rights requirements.

trend_intelligence.principle: Trends are discovery signals, not authority; prioritize learning value, accuracy, safety, accessibility, culture, rights and effort.

safety_and_release_gates: child age suitability and cultural review
caption, accessibility and embedded text QA
owner approval before public publishing or monetized distribution

monetization.child_directed_ad_policy: No inappropriate targeted advertising or exploitative monetization.
